\(A = {@dset(A)@}\), \(B = {@dset(B)@}\), \(C = {@dset(C)@}\) and \(D = {@Dd@}\). Is each statement true or false?

(a) \(A \subset B\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

(b) \(B \supseteq C\) [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

(c) \(A\) and \(C\) are disjoint. [[input:ans3]] [[validation:ans3]] [[feedback:prt3]]

(d) \(D\) is a singleton. [[input:ans4]] [[validation:ans4]] [[feedback:prt4]]
